title: Hardware-Assisted Multi-Stage Ransomware Detection with Adaptive Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.15951v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ransomware is a fast-escalating privacy threat causing significant financial and data losses worldwide. As attacks grow more sophisticated, traditional static signatures and dynamic behavior analysis struggle to defend. In this paper, we propose an novel framework that couples software-level scanning with hardware-level microprocessor activity monitoring to achieve efficient ransomware detection and mitigation. The contributions are threefold: (1) we employ adversarial training to harden static analysis against obfuscation and leverage hardware-assisted monitoring for real-time detection; (2) we integrate neural architecture search (NAS) to automatically tailor models for stronger generalizability; and (3) We validate the proposed approach through extensive experiments, demonstrating substantially improved detection accuracy and reduced latency compared with existing methods. translated_title: 硬件辅助的自适应机器学习多阶段勒索软件检测
translated_abstract: 勒索软件是一种快速升级的隐私威胁，在全球范围内造成了巨大的财务和数据损失。随着攻击手段日益复杂，传统的静态特征签名和动态行为分析已难以有效防御。在本文中，我们提出了一个新颖的框架，将软件级扫描与硬件级微处理器活动监控相结合，以实现高效的勒索软件检测与缓解。主要贡献有三点：（1）我们采用对抗性训练来强化静态分析以抵御混淆攻击，并利用硬件辅助监控实现实时检测；（2）我们集成神经架构搜索（NAS）来自动定制模型，从而获得更强的泛化能力；（3）我们通过大量实验验证了所提出的方法，证明与现有方法相比，检测准确率大幅提升且延迟显著降低。此外，该方法还提供了跟踪级的可解释性……
tldr: 该论文提出一种将软件级扫描与硬件级微处理器活动监控相结合的多阶段勒索软件检测框架，通过对抗性训练抵御混淆攻击、神经架构搜索自动定制模型，在显著提升检测准确率的同时降低了延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-stage ransomware detection framework that couples software-level scanning with hardware-assisted microprocessor activity monitoring, leveraging adversarial training and neural architecture search to substantially improve detection accuracy while reducing latency.
